threat_event: Fraudulent wire sent after an attacker changes a business customer phone number on file by email, so the wire callback reaches the attacker (business email compromise)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contact-information changes accepted from email or phone without out-of-band verification (11 of 40 sampled changes unverified); no customer alert on changes
existing_controls: Required callback field in the payments hub; maker-checker; POL-02 callback standard
treatment_plan: Out-of-band verification (call to the prior number or in-branch identification) for every contact-information change; customer alert to old and new contacts; 10-day hold on wires after a contact change for non-face-to-face requests
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$1.5M per event (largest business wires; bond deductible $100K)

threat_event: Real-time phishing site relays a business online banking user one-time code; attacker adds a beneficiary and sends wires or ACH
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One-time codes (SMS for 12% of business users) are not phishing-resistant; new beneficiaries not confirmed out of band; beneficiary changes not in the SIEM
existing_controls: MFA required for business users; dual approval above $100,000; provider fraud scoring (AI-003)
treatment_plan: App-based push with number matching or passkeys for all business users; out-of-band confirmation of every new beneficiary; beneficiary-change alerts to treasury management and the SIEM

threat_event: Ransomware at the core processor takes the core down for several days, stopping branch, payment, and correspondent processing
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group (at a third party)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single core processor; contract sets no recovery time or incident notice terms; offline procedures cover only part of a day
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; BP-01 to BP-03; BP-05 to BP-09; BP-13 to BP-15
existing_controls: Core processor SOC 2 (RTO 4 h, RPO 15 min); annual DR test participation; offline teller mode
treatment_plan: Recovery and incident notice terms at the 2027 renewal; extended offline procedures (72 hours) for branches, wires, and correspondent services; core outage runbook and tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Region failure or payments hub corruption, and failover takes longer than the 4-hour RTO, so wires and correspondent payments miss settlement
threat_source: Cloud region outage or failed upgrade
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 failover test took 9 hours; manual DNS, Federal Reserve connection, and wire reconciliation steps; no retest
existing_controls: Backups in a second region; secondary wire room
treatment_plan: Scripted failover; pre-approved second-region Federal Reserve connection; in-flight wire reconciliation runbook; semiannual failover tests
exposure_estimate_usd: $150K-$600K per day of outage, plus interest claims

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts bank-managed servers, file shares, and item processing, and spreads toward the payments hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 unsupported item processing servers; 18% of on-premises servers late on critical patches; core and payments hub administrators outside PAM
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; MFA for all; write-once backups in a second region; PAM for directory and cloud
treatment_plan: Replace legacy servers; patch SLA enforcement; extend PAM; full restore tests of on-premises servers

threat_event: Employee uses excess core entitlements to view customer information or change accounts beyond their job
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core roles not tied to role templates; 26% of sampled teller and universal banker users exceed their role
existing_controls: Quarterly manager reviews; unique core logons
treatment_plan: Role templates for all branch and operations jobs; entitlement clean-up; reviews against templates

threat_event: Attacker or insider uses a core security administrator or payments hub administrator account to create users, raise limits, or change callback settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core and payments hub administrators outside PAM; everyday accounts used for administration
existing_controls: Workforce MFA; administrator actions logged in the applications
treatment_plan: Separate privileged accounts in PAM with hardware keys; just-in-time elevation; admin actions to the SIEM

threat_event: A notification incident is determined late or reported late to the OCC, or not reported to the Federal Reserve for the holding company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No determination criteria in the plan; Federal Reserve step missing; executives not exercised
existing_controls: Plan includes the OCC 36-hour notice
treatment_plan: Determination criteria, clock, and contacts in the P08 runbooks; executive tabletop

threat_event: The bank does not notify its respondent banks as soon as possible when an incident disrupts correspondent services for 4 hours or more
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No outbound 53.4 procedure; respondents have given no designated contacts
existing_controls: Correspondent operations call respondents informally
treatment_plan: Collect designated contacts from all 18 respondents; outbound notice step in both P08 runbooks

threat_event: A bank service provider incident is not communicated to the right people in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Designated 53.4 contacts given to 3 of 7 bank service providers; 9 critical contracts lack notice time frames
existing_controls: Contacts sent to the core processor, digital banking provider, and card processor
treatment_plan: Send contacts to the other 4 providers; side letters with notice time frames; renewal terms

threat_event: The bank relies on provider controls whose CUECs it does not operate, so inherited controls fail silently
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUECs mapped only for the core processor; exceptions not followed up for other providers
existing_controls: SOC reports collected for 34 critical vendors
treatment_plan: CUEC mapping and exception follow-up for all Tier 1 vendors (P09 method)

threat_event: The board cannot tell whether cyber risk is within appetite because tolerances are not measurable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Qualitative cyber appetite; qualitative board reports
existing_controls: Enterprise risk appetite (2025); annual board report
treatment_plan: Measurable cyber tolerances and key risk indicators (this report, section 1) for board approval on 2026-10-20; quarterly reporting

threat_event: Unauthorized beneficiary, template, limit, or contact-information changes go unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payments hub, correspondent portal, and core security logs not in the SIEM; no change-anomaly use cases
existing_controls: Daily wire exception report; maker-checker
treatment_plan: Onboard sources to the SIEM; use cases for changes followed by payments; daily change report to payments operations

threat_event: Legacy item processing servers are compromised or fail and cannot be rebuilt quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 servers on an unsupported operating system; no tested rebuild
existing_controls: Isolated segment; EDR; nightly backup
treatment_plan: Replace with the item processing provider hosted service; tested rebuild procedure until then

threat_event: Unpatched on-premises server exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 18% of on-premises servers missed the 30-day critical patch target
existing_controls: Monthly scans; EDR
treatment_plan: Patch SLA tracked weekly by the CIO; exceptions only through POL-01 4.7

threat_event: Consumer online banking account takeover by credential stuffing or SIM swap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS code only on new-device sign-in; no step-up for new external transfer recipients
existing_controls: Lockout after 5 attempts; device recognition; provider fraud scoring
treatment_plan: App-based or passkey MFA offered to all consumers; step-up for new recipients

threat_event: AI credit model gives adverse action reasons that are not specific or accurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes not reviewed against 12 CFR 1002.9(b)(2); 9 of 40 sampled notices used "score below threshold"
existing_controls: Loan officer makes the final decision
treatment_plan: Reason-code mapping review by Compliance; corrected statements to affected applicants (P10)

threat_event: AI credit model disadvantages applicants on a prohibited basis through proxy variables
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fair lending testing used vendor national data; industry and location inputs not tested as proxies on bank data
existing_controls: Human decision; limit of $500,000
treatment_plan: Fairness testing on bank data before the next model release; quarterly monitoring (P10)

threat_event: AI credit model performance drifts and approves weaker credits than expected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No outcomes validation on bank data; no drift monitoring
existing_controls: Conceptual review by the Model Risk Manager (2025)
treatment_plan: Outcomes validation and monthly drift monitoring (P10)

threat_event: Customer service chatbot gives wrong information about fees, disputes, or fraud, or collects NPI it should not
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Launched without compliance or model risk review; no transcript review
existing_controls: Chatbot cannot see accounts; hand-off to agents
treatment_plan: Compliance review of answers; block NPI entry; monthly transcript sampling (P10)

threat_event: Staff enter customer information into an unapproved generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools reachable from bank devices; enterprise assistant only in pilot
existing_controls: POL-05 prohibits it
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI sites; roll out the approved assistant with data controls (P10)

threat_event: AML alert scoring suppresses alerts that should have been investigated, leading to missed SARs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alert scoring thresholds tuned by the vendor; below-threshold testing annual only
existing_controls: Annual model validation; BSA Officer oversight
treatment_plan: Quarterly below-threshold sampling; validation of the scoring model (P10)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the headquarters campus (operations center, primary wire room, server room) for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary operations, wire room, and server room on one campus
existing_controls: Georgia alternate operations site; secondary wire room; cloud-hosted payments hub
treatment_plan: Annual full relocation exercise to the Georgia site; move item processing off the campus server room

threat_event: The secondary wire room cannot process correspondent volume during a relocation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Secondary site exercised only for customer wires; 4 cross-trained staff
existing_controls: 2 payments workstations at the secondary site
treatment_plan: Cross-train 6 correspondent staff; include correspondent processing in the annual exercise

threat_event: A respondent user account is taken over and used to send fraudulent wires through the correspondent portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal relies on respondent user hygiene; no velocity or new-beneficiary checks for respondents
existing_controls: App-based MFA; respondent-level limits
treatment_plan: New-beneficiary and velocity alerts; respondent dual approval above set amounts

threat_event: Respondents leave or claim damages because service commitments and assurance are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 agreements have no security, recovery, or notice terms; no SOC report
existing_controls: Relationship management
treatment_plan: Updated respondent agreement; SOC 2 Type 2 readiness (P09)
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to $6M a year of fee revenue at stake

threat_event: A payments hub administrator colludes with a wire operator and changes approval limits or callback settings to push a fraudulent wire
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrators can change limits and callback settings without a second approver
existing_controls: Maker-checker; background checks; daily reconciliation
treatment_plan: Dual approval for configuration changes; change alerts to the ISO

threat_event: Voice impersonation (including synthetic voice) persuades contact center staff to change contact details or reveal account information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based caller verification; no training on synthetic voice
existing_controls: Caller verification questions
treatment_plan: One-time passcode to the app or number on file before any change; staff training

threat_event: Check fraud through altered or counterfeit checks and mobile deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Positive pay used by 700 of 4,100 business customers
existing_controls: Positive pay; mobile deposit limits; item processing fraud rules
treatment_plan: Positive pay offers to all business customers; image analytics review

threat_event: ATM or interactive teller machine skimming or logical attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 off-site machines with limited monitoring
existing_controls: Anti-skimming hardware; processor fraud monitoring
treatment_plan: Tamper alerts and quarterly inspection of off-site machines

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes the data warehouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warehouse holds NPI; masking not applied to all roles
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; posture monitoring; private access only
treatment_plan: Masking for all non-analyst roles; quarterly access review

threat_event: Attacker with cloud administrator rights deletes backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup account isolated with write-once retention and separate credentials
existing_controls: Write-once retention; separate credentials; second region
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Moderate is within appetite given the isolation design; revisit after the full restore test

threat_event: Loan documents or statements with NPI emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff email NPI to customers; outbound data loss prevention in monitor mode
existing_controls: TLS for email; data loss prevention in monitor mode
treatment_plan: Secure document portal for loan files; block mode for account numbers

threat_event: Laptop with customer information lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Relationship managers carry laptops
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Information Security Officer: encryption keeps residual risk Low

threat_event: Distributed denial of service makes online banking or the correspondent portal unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Services depend on provider edge protection
existing_controls: Provider and cloud edge protection per SOC reports
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Information Security Officer: residual risk Low

threat_event: Customer information recovered from disposed drives or paper
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certified destruction in place for drives and paper
existing_controls: Certified vendor with serial-number certificates
treatment_plan: Annual vendor audit

threat_event: MSSP misses or delays escalation of a high-severity alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single MSSP; SIEM platform carved out of its SOC 2
existing_controls: 30-minute escalation clause; monthly service reviews
treatment_plan: Monthly escalation metrics; quarterly detection tests; SIEM platform SOC 2 review

threat_event: Systems configured inconsistently because supporting standards are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Configuration, logging, cryptography, third-party tiering, and AI standards missing or thin
existing_controls: Policies (2024); cloud guardrails
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01 to STD-08 (P06 standards index)

threat_event: A former employee keeps core access after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core access removed manually; 9 of 25 sampled terminations removed late (P07)
existing_controls: Federated access disabled automatically
treatment_plan: Core removal in the automated termination workflow; daily reconciliation

threat_event: Transferred employees keep prior core roles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfers do not trigger role review
existing_controls: Quarterly reviews
treatment_plan: Transfer workflow removes prior roles within 5 business days

threat_event: A relationship manager mailbox is compromised and used to send payment instructions or harvest customer documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Relationship managers exchange documents and payment requests by email
existing_controls: Workforce MFA with number matching; email filtering; monthly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Mailbox rule alerts; secure document portal; token theft detection

threat_event: Identity provider outage prevents staff from reaching critical systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Most systems depend on federation
existing_controls: Provider redundancy; break-glass for the cloud management account
treatment_plan: Break-glass accounts for the payments hub and admin console; quarterly test

threat_event: Card processor compromise exposes cardholder data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank relies on the processor controls
existing_controls: SOC 2 reviewed; card fraud monitoring
treatment_plan: Annual SOC review with CUEC mapping

threat_event: Examiners criticize third-party oversight and issue a matter requiring attention
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Oversight does not scale (gap 5)
existing_controls: Tiering and SOC collection
treatment_plan: Complete P09 vendor review program for all Tier 1 vendors

threat_event: Breach notices to residents of Georgia or other states are late or incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix covered Florida only before 2026
existing_controls: Counsel reviews each notice
treatment_plan: Multi-state workflow in the P08 matrix; counsel checklist per state

threat_event: Identity theft Red Flags program misses new channels (digital account opening, contact changes by email)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program last updated 2022; no Red Flags for contact-change requests
existing_controls: Customer identification program; Red Flags program (2022)
treatment_plan: Update the Red Flags program and obtain board committee approval

threat_event: Unauthorized or erroneous change to payments hub business configuration (limits, approval rules, callback fields)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business configuration changed outside change control; no baseline
existing_controls: Application audit trail
treatment_plan: Configuration baseline; changes through the change advisory board with second approval

threat_event: Payments hub vendor standing VPN used as an entry point
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor VPN into production; no per-session approval or recording
existing_controls: Named vendor accounts with MFA
treatment_plan: Vendor access through PAM with per-session approval and recording

threat_event: Vendor-created generic administrator accounts in the correspondent portal used to send or approve payments (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 generic administrator accounts enabled since go-live with a vendor default password pattern; not in any access review
existing_controls: Accounts disabled 2026-08-14; portal login logs show no use since 2025-05
treatment_plan: Remove the accounts; vendor attestation that no other default accounts exist; add portal to quarterly reviews; review 18 months of portal logs

threat_event: The small security team cannot sustain first-line operations and second-line oversight at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ISO and 3 analysts run scanning and MSSP triage and also oversee the program
existing_controls: Co-sourced IT audit tests controls independently
treatment_plan: Move vulnerability scanning operations to IT; add a security engineer in the 2027 budget
